assertions.assertion: Explains that IdentityServer matches protocol endpoints with its own middleware (not ASP.NET Core endpoint routing), so named per-endpoint rate limiting policies do not apply to /connect/token or /connect/authorize
assertions.rationale: States explicitly that IdentityServer matches protocol endpoints with its own middleware, not endpoint routing, so named policies attach no metadata and never run on /connect/token or /connect/authorize.

assertions.assertion: States that only the global limiter applies to protocol endpoints and shows partitioning the global limiter on context.Request.Path
assertions.rationale: Says only the global limiter applies to protocol endpoints and partitions GlobalLimiter on $"{ip}:{context.Request.Path}".

assertions.assertion: Registers the rate limiter middleware (UseRateLimiter) before app.UseIdentityServer()
assertions.rationale: Shows app.UseRateLimiter() before app.UseIdentityServer() and explains why order matters.

assertions.assertion: Notes that IdentityServer has no built-in rate limiting and/or mentions ICustomTokenRequestValidator (AddCustomTokenRequestValidator) for identity-aware limits
assertions.rationale: States IdentityServer has no built-in rate limiting and shows an ICustomTokenRequestValidator with AddCustomTokenRequestValidator for identity-aware limits.
